ideas.title: Minnesota Medicaid fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the $325K SNAP fraud scheme involving a Minnesota woman.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and examine the management of Medicaid funds in Minnesota.
questions: What measures are being taken to prevent similar fraud?
ideas.insight: This story could reveal potential issues with Medicaid management and oversight in Minnesota.

ideas.title: Gateway Tunnel funding issues
ideas.description: Investigate the ongoing funding issues with the Gateway Tunnel project.
ideas.angle: Examine the impact of funding freezes on the project's timeline and budget.
questions: What are the causes of the funding issues?
ideas.insight: This story could reveal potential issues with project management and funding allocation.
